Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Dinabandhu Mitra (author, Wikidata Q2075170), died 1873; Michael Madhusudan Dutt (translator, Wikidata Q666864), died 1873. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Mitra, Dinabandhu, 1829-1874; Dutt, Michael Madhusudan, 1824-1873 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Nil darpan, or, The indigo planting mirror : a drama, Calcutta : C.H. Manuel, 1861, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/nildarpanorindig00mitriala. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 86%, 89%, 91% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Dinabandhu Mitra, Michael Madhusudan Dutt, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
